Made by 주식회사 네추럴웨이 · Once a day · 1 sachet

This product combines 8.5mg of Zinc, 300mg of Phosphatidylserine as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

  • Once a day (1 sachet): 8.5mg Zinc, 300mg Phosphatidylserine

  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Phosphatidylserine
    • May help improve cognitive function that declines with aging, maintain skin health from UV-induced skin damage, support skin moisturizing.

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 sachet per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Zinc labelled (8.5mg / 2000mg), 80~150%
Phosphatidylserine labelled (300mg / 2000mg), 80~120%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 흰노랑색의 분말
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage 실온보관 (1~35℃)

  • Those who want to take Zinc · Phosphatidylserine together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult a professional before use · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

This product combines 8.5mg of Zinc, 300mg of Phosphatidylserine as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • 2 times a day (1 sachet): 8.5mg Zinc, 300mg Phosphatidylserine
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)오투바이오

  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Phosphatidylserine
    • May help improve cognitive function that declines with aging, maintain skin health from UV-induced skin damage, support skin moisturizing.

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

2 times a day1 sachet per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Zinc labelled (8.5mg / 6000mg), 80~150%
Phosphatidylserine labelled (300mg / 6000mg), 80~120%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 회황색의 분말
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Zinc · Phosphatidylserine together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult a professional before use · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

Phosphatidylserine labelled (300mg / 560mg), 80~120%
